record.paper_title: Selection Principles and Special Sets of Reals
record.original_question: Is there a model of set theory in which the Borel property Sfin(BΩ, BΩ) is additive?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be a separable metrizable (zero-dimensional) topological space, and let B(X) denote the collection of countable covers of X by Borel sets. A Borel cover U of X is called a Borel ω-cover if X itself is not in U and for every finite subset F ⊆ X there exists U ∈ U with F ⊆ U; let BΩ(X) be the family of all Borel ω-covers of X.

For families A and B of covers of X, the selection principle Sfin(A, B) asserts: for every sequence (Un : n ∈ ω) of elements of A there exist finite subsets Fn ⊆ Un such that ⋃_{n∈ω} Fn ∈ B. A topological property P (regarded as a class of sets of reals) is called additive if whenever X and Y are sets of reals satisfying P, the union X ∪ Y also satisfies P.

Question: Is there a model of ZFC in which the property Sfin(BΩ, BΩ) is additive — that is, in which for all sets of reals X, Y satisfying Sfin(BΩ(X), BΩ(X)) and Sfin(BΩ(Y), BΩ(Y)) respectively, the union X ∪ Y satisfies Sfin(BΩ(X∪Y), BΩ(X∪Y))?
artifact.category_tag: selection principles and special sets of reals
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches indicate that the question of whether Sfin(BΩ, BΩ) is consistently additive (equivalently, consistently closed under finite unions) remains an open problem in the theory of selection principles. It is listed as an open problem in surveys on selection principles and Borel covering properties, with no resolution found in the search results.

status_evidence.title: Selection principles in mathematics: A milestone of open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing open problems about selection principles including additivity questions for Sfin variants.
status_evidence.claim: The additivity question for Sfin(BΩ, BΩ) appears among the open problems in the selection principles literature.

status_evidence.title: Selection principles and proofs from the Book
status_evidence.snippet: Recent survey of selection principles results; additivity of Borel ω-cover properties remains discussed as open.
status_evidence.claim: As of recent surveys, the consistency of additivity for Sfin(BΩ, BΩ) has not been established.
